Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1075097 (Arginase-1). Join activities to assays and target_dictionary, and join activities to compound_records and molecule_dictionary, then join compound_structures. Filter by target ChEMBL ID, standard type IC50, exact standard relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Return rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
